dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters with a high-contrast dark boundary that transitions sharply into a lighter interior. These are concentrated along the dorsal midline and lateral flanks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of small, low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters concentrated in the upper cervical and dorsal-anterior regions, characterized by sharp edges and a lack of internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli on the upper lateral surface form an irregular quadrilateral arrangement with the most distal points located near the dorsal-midline.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct radial pattern of high-contrast dark lines originates from the lower-right focal point of the subject's muzzle area.
